description: This file provides functions for resolving gateway probe authentication credentials, including handling secret inputs and error cases, for the OpenClaw system.

methods.name: buildGatewayProbeCredentialPolicy
methods.description: Constructs a credential policy object based on input parameters.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProbeAuth
methods.description: Resolves gateway probe authentication token or password based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProbeAuthWithSecretInputs
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves credentials with secret inputs, handling errors.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProbeAuthSafeWithSecretInputs
methods.description: Resolves credentials safely, returning warnings if secret references are unresolved.

methods.name: resolveGatewayProbeAuthSafe
methods.description: Safely resolves credentials, falling back to standard method and handling errors.
